earnings.title: Verisk Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Revenue was $809 million, up 5.3% , and up 7.4% on an organic constant currency (OCC) basis, a non-GAAP measure.
Diluted GAAP earnings per share (EPS) was $1.70 , up 5.6% .
Diluted adjusted EPS, a non-GAAP measure, was $1.96 , up 14.0% .
Net cash provided by operating activities was $ 267 million, down 33.8% and free cash flow, a non-GAAP measure, was $ 200 million, down 40.5% .
